_readme: S530 SkyBuffaloberry, 2026-10-30. The front matter's graduation requirements for an associate degree at Los Angeles Valley: how many units the LACCD GE Plan and Cal-GETC carry, and whether the catalog says electives make up the 60. Its words become the college's reconcile step (ge_units and electives_fill_degree, as Cerritos's and Taft's). Pages 1-51 only, before the program pages. One load, no model call.

questions.ge_units: The units of the LACCD GE Plan and Cal-GETC, and the catalog's words for an associate degree's 60 units.
